title: 章三 启迪
slug: 罪恶之城全本免费-罪恶之城最新章节列表
content_zh:
阁楼是平时堆放杂物的地方，但也清扫得干干净净。伊莲搬开了一个箱子，露出后面的一座小小祭坛。祭坛是石质的，基础部分用细腻而准确的笔法勾勒出繁复的魔法阵。只是本应摆放神像的位置，现在却是空白。
伊莲仔细清理着祭坛，把上面最微小的灰尘也擦拭得干干净净。然后才站起来，目光落在旁边箱子上随意摆放着的一部厚书上。这本书厚得出奇，怕是有近千页，而且相当于普通魔法书的四本那么大，至少重十几公斤。青铜色的封面闪耀着光泽，纤尘不染，显然经常被翻阅。伊莲一怔，她已经很久没有碰过它了，那么显然就是李察在读。只是没想到，那个小家伙竟然读得这么频繁，这么起劲。
伊莲走过去，伸手不止一次私下议论过她的双手。
书的封面是真正的青铜铸成，粗重冰冷，散发着岁月的沉重。伊莲知道，在青铜中，如星辰般散落着数以百计的水晶颗粒，当它们同时激发时就会构成一个微型祭坛，当使用者足够虔诚和强大时，甚至可以通过它去聆听月神艾露西娅的声音！
在扉页上，用优美的古精灵语书写着赞颂月神艾露西娅的长诗。直至今日，伊莲仍然记得这首赞美诗的每一个音节。伊莲随手翻阅着，质感十足的书页如流水般在指间掠过，上面或是大段的精灵文字，或是一幅幅栩栩如生的插画。和人类的教典不同，它的内容中月神的教义只占了很少一部分，倒有许多月神艾露西娅成神前的事迹。因此除了诺兰德大陆之外，还包含了许许多多大陆以外，甚至是异位面的内容。小李察大概就是把它当成了一本风物地理大全，才看得津津有味。
这本除了厚重之外，看不出有何出奇之处的大书，就是精灵王庭曾经最珍贵的宝物，月之女神艾露西亚的圣典。
圣典中其实还记载了七个月之女神独有的神术，但只有得到女神认可的人才能够看到并且使用。而当年的她，可以使用其中五个。除了王庭的大德鲁依，她是领悟神术最多的祭祀。那即代表了实力，也代表着女神的认可。但现在，即使是付出巨大的代价，她能够激发的神术也只有一个，还是借助了圣典本身的力量。
七个神术，如水般在她心底流过。
“艾露西娅的命运”神术：启迪；
“艾露西娅的眷顾”神术：痊愈；
“艾露西娅的愤怒”神术：制裁；
“艾露西娅之剑”神术：银月武装；
“艾露西娅的意志”神术：审判
还有两个神术，其中一个是她也未能掌握的“艾露西娅之心”神术：预见。
而第七神术，则是根本只是记载于圣典，却从来没有人能够使用，那即是“艾露西娅的迷茫”，神术：月之暗面。
伊莲把手放在圣典上，静静感受着圣典内残留的一丝神圣气息。第五颗月亮此际正悬在中天，清冷的月光透过屋顶的天窗，恰好照射在她的身上。月光中隐含的一丝神力悄然渗入她的身体，积蓄起来，为十几天后的仪式作着储备。
神术:启迪，就是小李察十岁的生日礼物。
在小李察生日这一天，还是子夜时分，他就被叫了起来，带上阁楼，跪到了祭坛前。李察面前的圣典已经翻到了特定的那一页，上面浮现几行他从未见过的祷言。那是古精灵语，这种艰深晦涩的语言李察已经掌握得和通用语一样纯熟。祷言的内容仍是对月之女神的赞美和祈求，可是李察在心中默念着，却忽然有种奇异的感觉，似乎身体正在变得透明，而冥冥之中有什么东西本来是漫无目的地逡巡徘徊，却好像突然发现了什么，向着他飞了过来，一下扑入身体。李察感到胸腹间多了一道冰流，倏然延展，向四肢小腹扩散开去。这种感觉一闪而逝，虽然异常清晰，但是在祭神或魔法仪式时有特殊感觉是很常见的事，有很多仪式甚至需要忍受强烈的痛苦。所以小李察什么都没有说，而是按照妈妈所要求的继续逐渐清空自己的心灵。

content_en:
The attic is a place where clutter is usually stored, but it is also kept clean. Elaine moved a box away, revealing a small altar behind it. The altar is made of stone, and the basic part outlines a complex magic circle with delicate and accurate brushwork. But the place where the statue of the god should have been placed is now blank.
Elaine carefully cleaned the altar, wiping away even the tiniest dust. Then he stood up and his eyes fell on a thick book randomly placed on the box next to him. This book is surprisingly thick, probably close to a thousand pages, and is as big as four ordinary magic books, and weighs at least ten kilograms. The bronze cover was shiny and spotless, obviously being thumbed through frequently. Elaine was startled. She hadn't touched it for a long time, so it was obviously Richard who was reading it. I just didn't expect that the little guy would read so frequently and with such enthusiasm.
Elaine walked over, extending her hands that had been whispered about more than once.
The cover of the book is made of real bronze, thick and cold, exuding the heaviness of time. Elaine knew that hundreds of crystal particles were scattered like stars in the bronze. When they were activated at the same time, they would form a miniature altar. When the user was pious and powerful enough, he could even listen to the voice of the Moon Goddess Elusia through it!
On the title page, a long poem praising the moon goddess Elusia is written in beautiful ancient Elf language. To this day, Elaine still remembers every syllable of this hymn. Elaine flipped through it casually, and the richly textured pages passed between her fingers like running water. There were either large sections of elven text or lifelike illustrations on them. Unlike human scriptures, its content only accounts for a small part of the teachings of the Moon God, but there are many deeds of the Moon God Elusia before she became a god. Therefore, in addition to the continent of Noland, it also contains content from many other continents and even alien planes. Little Richard probably regarded it as an encyclopedia of scenery and geography, so he read it with gusto.
This big book, which has nothing special about it except that it is thick, is the most precious treasure of the Elven Court, the Holy Book of the Moon Goddess Elucia.
The holy book actually records the unique magic of the Seven Moon Goddess, but only those approved by the goddess can see and use it. Back then, she could use five of them. Apart from the Archdruid of the Royal Court, she is the priest who has the most understanding of divine magic. That not only represents strength, but also represents the approval of the goddess. But now, even if she pays a huge price, there is only one magical spell she can inspire, and she relies on the power of the Holy Scripture itself.
The seven divine arts flowed through her heart like water.
"Elucia's Destiny" divine spell: enlightenment;
"Elucia's Blessing" magic: healing;
"Elucia's Wrath" magical spell: Sanction;
"Elucia's Sword" magic: Silver Moon Arms;
"Elucia's Will" Magic: Judgment
There are also two magical arts, one of which is the "Heart of Elusia" magical spell that she also failed to master: foresight.
As for the seventh divine art, it is only recorded in the Holy Scriptures, but no one has ever been able to use it. That is "Elcia's Confusion", the divine art: Dark Side of the Moon.
Elaine put her hand on the holy book and quietly felt the trace of sacred breath remaining in the holy book. The fifth moon was hanging in the sky at this time, and the cool moonlight shined on her through the skylight on the roof. A trace of divine power hidden in the moonlight quietly seeped into her body and was accumulated for the ceremony that would take place more than ten days later.
Magic: Enlightenment is Little Richard's tenth birthday gift.
On Little Richard's birthday, at midnight, he was called up, taken to the attic, and knelt in front of the altar. The holy book in front of Richard had turned to a specific page, and several lines of prayers that he had never seen appeared on it. That was the ancient Elvish language. Richard had already mastered this difficult and obscure language.The language is equally sophisticated. The content of the prayer was still praising and praying to the Moon Goddess, but while Richard was chanting silently in his heart, he suddenly had a strange feeling, as if his body was becoming transparent, and something in the dark that was originally wandering aimlessly seemed to suddenly find something, flew towards him, and jumped into his body. Richard felt an ice flow between his chest and abdomen, which suddenly extended and spread to his limbs and lower abdomen. This feeling is fleeting, although it is extremely clear, but it is very common to have special feelings during sacrifices to gods or magical rituals, and many rituals even require enduring intense pain. So little Richard didn't say anything, but continued to gradually empty his mind as his mother asked.
